independent_method: Immutable photometric-input identity; independent density integral and critical-density radius construction; all forecasts, structural states, diagnostics, fits, minima, exclusions, comparator copies and bootstraps. No analysis-code imports.
limits: Mref is dark-matter-only-equivalent reference M200c; dark component is (1-fb)Mref. This is an explicit deterministic convention, not an empirical halo mass measurement.
Mass mapping and concentration are conditional on common photometric stellar M/L and an approximate HI-plus-stellar mass proxy.
Published concentration-mass calibration is extrapolated for some low-mass objects; scatter and baryonic halo response are omitted.
Fixed Planck cosmology and concentration-mass relation supply structural priors, not a full LambdaCDM prediction.
No observed radius tests the imposed outer truncation; finite total mass is a declared extrapolation.
The three-coefficient size-model RMS advantage is small, changes sign across CV seeds and has descriptive intervals spanning zero; median speed error is worse than RAR.
No per-galaxy target-informed halo parameter is fitted in held-out forecasts; affine mapping coefficients are shared.
